item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-11-06 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 4 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Network Edge / VPN is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (2). Ivanti has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-102764 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 646 positions.
